Monica / team,

Quick technical sketch attached (capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx, isolation_overlay_diagram.png). Short answers:
- Feasible: Yes. We can spin 3 additional logical clusters in their Private VPC w/ explicit network ACLs.
- Capacity: Each cluster -> 8x A100-equivalent GPU nodes (recommended 40GB per node), total: 24 nodes.
- Provisioning timeline: 4–6 weeks for reserved capacity ordering + 1 week for networking and tenant bootstrapping. Given mid-Jan target, we should start procurement immediately.

Commercial note (ballpark):
- If Arcadia converts the added units to a 36-month committed term, we can offer a 15% unit discount on the added capacity vs monthly on-demand.
- One-time provisioning/setup fee: $18,000 (networking + validation + runbook handoff).
- Estimated monthly AMU after discount: $28,500 (for the added clusters) — final numbers will need procurement-approved SKUs.
